actual_evidence: Table 1. Effect of different dosage of SnCl4 and MgCl2 on the dehydration of xylose into furfural. Entry SnCl4 (mol%) MgCl2 (mol%) Furfural Yield (%) 1 10 0 71.1 2 8 2 69.8 3 8 0 62.0 4 5 5 68.8 5 5 0 52.4 6 0 10 4.5 Reaction conditions: 200 mg xylose, 1000 mg of EMIMBr; 130 ◦C; 1 h.
explanation: 该块给出与题目同一变量（SnCl4 用量）的实测收率表：5 mol% 52.4%、8 mol% 62.0%、10 mol% 71.1%，即必需事实中『用量增加—收率上升』这一半的定量依据直接落在块内；但块内没有『同时促进副反应』的机理句。块内唯一的副反应表述（massive brown residues in EMIMBF4）针对的是溶剂 EMIMBF4，不是锡盐用量。缺机理项 → 不能判 3，仅部分覆盖 → 维持 2。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读

actual_evidence: Figure 9. Time profile for the conversion of xylan to furfural in the EMIMBr/SnCl4 system. explanation: 通读全块：只有 Figure 9 的图注（木聚糖时间曲线）与 Figure 10 图注、以及加盐酸助催化剂的讨论（54.6% vs 54.5%）。必需事实的 50.1%（1 h）与 33.0%（4 h）两个数值在块内完全不出现，时间-收率趋势本身也未以文字给出。图注虽指向该趋势的数据来源，但不构成对必需事实的直接支持。块与题目同论文、同体系（EMIMBr/SnCl4）、同原料（xylan），只是条件（含水量、是否加酸）不同 → 归 L1a『同体系不同条件』= 1。旧判 2 过高，且旧理由自称 L1b（1 级类目）与所标 2 级自相矛盾。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读

explanation: 该块只交代了优化方法：用 RSM 优化 time / temperature / LiBr wt.% 三个参数，并描述了统计口径（95% 置信、t 检验、Statistica）。157.3 ◦C、1.74 min、8.19 wt.% 三个最优值均未出现。属同论文的方法与数据口径段 → L1b = 1。旧判 2 过高，旧理由自称 L1b 且明说『未给出优化值』，与 2 级矛盾。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读

actual_evidence: Lignocelluloses are composed of cellulose (40–50%), hemicelluloses (25–35%) and lignin (15–20%) in an intricate structure where the components are rigidly associated through non-covalent bonds and covalent crosslinkages
explanation: 必答的是『三种主要聚合物组分』= 纤维素/半纤维素/木质素。该块逐字给出 cellulose、hemicelluloses、lignin 三项（并附 40–50%/25–35%/15–20% 组成占比），单独覆盖全部必需事实；且块来源 paper_2467240e9bec8a52db54345d 正是题目点名的 2018 综述本身，满足硬性来源限定。旧判 2 为漏判（旧理由自称 L1b，等级与理由同样矛盾）→ 升为 3。
review_basis: 原题+必需事实+硬性来源限定+完整原块阅读

actual_evidence: In catalyst-free conditions (without added acid), integration of biomass pretreatment with fast pyrolysis by hot water extraction (HWE)... ｜ high-temperature water has the potential to substitute solid and liquid acids as a catalyst since it efficiently promotes the transfer of furfural initially formed in the water phase into the organic phase. In this study, ethyl butyrate with its excellent distribution coefficient permitted to furnish furfural in 75% yield at 200◦C for 3 h
explanation: 该块来自题目点名的 2018 hemicellulose-to-furfural 综述（Frontiers in Chemistry, Delbecq et al.）。块内确实给出『无外加酸/无催化剂条件下热水（高温水）转化 D-木糖并同时向有机相萃取糠醛』这一半（乙酸乙酯萃取，200 ℃/3 h、75%），但全文不含 sc-CO2（超临界 CO2）萃取这一关键限定。部分覆盖 → 2，维持原判。

actual_evidence: These furanic compounds are obtained using a biphasic system composed of the saccharide acidic solution and a nonmiscible organic solvent, in which the CMF and furfural were continuously extracted, limiting the contact time of these furanics with the strong acid present in the aqueous phase. By doing so, the separation of furanics in the organic solvent from the acid becomes a simple phase separation.
explanation: 必需事实『用不混溶有机溶剂原位萃取 CMF』被逐字覆盖（biphasic system + nonmiscible organic solvent + CMF continuously extracted），并交代了分离即为简单相分离、有机溶剂可蒸发回用。块来源 paper_d1a4e8bfc7c58b30dda482f2 即题目点名的 2023 CMF 论文，满足硬性来源限定 → 3，维持原判。
